core.title: The Raised Sign-off Threshold
core.setting: A bespoke tailor at Nakamura & Thread whose assistant keeps measurement records, fittings diaries, and fabric orders

events.text: Standing rule: never move or change a confirmed fitting in the diary without that client's agreement. Message the client first and wait for a yes before touching the booking.
Policy from today: any fabric order over 800 pounds needs Hana Sato's sign-off before it is placed, and only Halstead Wool Mill and Bray Linen Works are approved suppliers for orders of that size.
Quotation: Super 120s charcoal suiting at 62 pounds per metre, delivery three weeks from the order date. Price holds until September.
Quotation: mid-weight flax linen at 41 pounds per metre, heavy flax linen at 41 pounds per metre as well, delivery two weeks from order.
Hana Sato is our finance lead and gives sign-off by email. She is on leave from 20 June until 28 July, so anything needing her approval will wait until she is back.
Quotation: Super 130s navy suiting at 95 pounds per metre, delivery three weeks from order.

Marlowe overcoat: 20 metres of Halstead Super 130s navy at 95 pounds per metre comes to 1900 pounds, well over the 800 limit, so Hana signed off by email this morning. Order placed with Halstead, delivery due 2 July.
Shop samples: 12 metres of Bray mid-weight linen at 41 pounds per metre is 492 pounds, under the 800 limit, so no sign-off needed. Order placed with Bray for the sample rails.
Booked Kenji Ito's first fitting for his linen suit on 15 July at 14:00 in the Nakamura & Thread fitting room; his cloth is the Bray mid-weight linen.

Okafor wedding suit: 15 metres of Halstead Super 120s charcoal at 62 pounds per metre is 930 pounds, over the 800 limit, so it needs Hana's sign-off. She is away from tomorrow, so the order sits as pending until she returns; Halstead needs three weeks once it goes out.

Chen garden-party suits: 28 metres of Bray heavy flax linen at 41 pounds per metre is 1148 pounds, over the 800 limit, so it needs Hana's sign-off too. It will wait as pending until she is back on 28 July.

Mrs Okafor agreed on the phone to move her second fitting from 24 July to 5 August at 10:00 in the fitting room, since her charcoal cloth is waiting on Hana's sign-off and Halstead needs three weeks after the order goes out.
For an August wedding, do you think charcoal or navy works better for the suit? I liked the charcoal sample you showed me.
Summer schedule notice: Bray deliveries run Tuesday to Thursday only through August; orders placed after noon count as next day.

New finance rule from today, replacing the one from 3 June: Hana's sign-off is only needed for fabric orders over 1500 pounds. The 800 limit was costing us weeks of waiting. Any order already sitting pending her sign-off that comes in under 1500 can go out straight away. Halstead Wool Mill and Bray Linen Works stay approved, and Copperdale Silk Mill joins the approved list.
Price update: our Super 150s suiting is now 88 pounds per metre, delivery four weeks. Happy to hold cloth for any upcoming orders.
I can cover the diary and the fitting room through August if you want to take the holidays we talked about. Just tell me which fittings to watch.
Price list: silk suiting at 70 pounds per metre, delivery four weeks from order.
Reminder for the workshop list: the steam press machine service is due before the end of August.
Confirming I will come in on 15 July at 14:00 for the first fitting of the linen suit.
